symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed constant $2^{-182}$ giving the power saving in the logarithmic factor.
symbols.quote: The main theorem of this wiki is that one fixed deterministic machine multiplies two $n$-bit integers, where $n$ is the number of bits in each input and $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is a fixed saving exponent, in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time.

symbols.name: recursion level
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels above the leaves, so that a chunk has $m^t$ digits.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the recursion level, so a chunk has $e=m^t$ radix-$q$ digits, and let $F(e)$ be the time divided by the stored volume $V$ at that level.

symbols.name: chunk digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-$q$ digits in each chunk being interchanged at a level, a count of digits.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the recursion level, so a chunk has $e=m^t$ radix-$q$ digits, and let $F(e)$ be the time divided by the stored volume $V$ at that level.

symbols.name: time per volume
symbols.meaning: The time of a call at a level divided by the stored volume it works on.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the recursion level, so a chunk has $e=m^t$ radix-$q$ digits, and let $F(e)$ be the time divided by the stored volume $V$ at that level.

relations.quote: The machine performs its address moves by [Fast interchange of address fields](fast-address-interchange.md).
It performs its butterfly layers by [Fast simultaneous butterfly layers](fast-butterfly-layers.md).

The machine places the coefficient list by the [Chinese-remainder map to prime cyclic axes](crt-address-map.md), and computes its convolution by [Convolution with retained transform order and cancelled permutations](ring-convolution-retained-order.md).
